name: aria2.onDownloadStart
description: Emitted when a download starts or resumes.

name: aria2.onDownloadPause
description: Emitted when a download is paused.

name: aria2.onDownloadStop
description: Emitted when a download is stopped by user intervention.

name: aria2.onDownloadComplete
description: Emitted when a download completes successfully.

name: aria2.onDownloadError
description: Emitted when a download stops due to an error.

name: aria2.onBtDownloadComplete
description: Emitted when a BitTorrent download completes seeding or finishes downloading files.
